data.current_summary: API entry point: endpoints and top supply snapshot (paid, $0.001)
data.current_description: Entry point to the x402 Carbon Retirement API on Base. Returns every endpoint you need plus a live snapshot of the top 3 carbon classes and marketplace listings by liquidity. Discover, quote and certificate are free. Retiring is paid: each retirement costs the credit price plus a fee, sent from your own wallet (prepare/retire) or relayed from a signed USDC authorization (prepare-auth + POST actions/retire). Full spec at /openapi.json. Paid per call with a standard x402 v2 `exact` USDC payment on Base, settled by the Coinbase facilitator. GET /api/discover returns the full catalog for free.
data.summary_suggestion: Get API index and top carbon supply snapshot
data.description_suggestion: Returns the API index with all available endpoints and a live snapshot of the top 3 carbon classes and marketplace listings ranked by liquidity. This is a paid operation ($0.001 USDC) that provides a quick overview of available carbon supply. Use /api/discover for the complete free catalog. Responses include USDC-per-tonne prices and project metadata for each listing.

data.current_summary: Build the authorization to sign for a relayed retirement
data.current_description: Use to pay for a retirement without sending a transaction. Returns EIP-712 `typedData` (EIP-3009 for USDC, EIP-2612 permit for kVCM) and a ready-to-send `actionsRetireRequest`. Sign `typedData` exactly as returned, set `authPayload.signature`, and POST the request to /api/actions/retire. Requires `details.beneficiaryAddress` or `beneficiaryIsPayer=true`. Paid: the signed authorization funds the retirement, costing the credit price plus a fee and executor gas.
data.description_suggestion: Use to enable non-custodial retirement payment via signed authorization. Returns EIP-712 `typedData` for signing (EIP-3009 for USDC or EIP-2612 permit for kVCM) and a ready-to-send `actionsRetireRequest`. Sign the `typedData` exactly as returned, add the signature to `authPayload.signature`, and POST the complete request to /api/actions/retire. Requires either `details.beneficiaryAddress` (retirement beneficiary) or `beneficiaryIsPayer=true` (payer is beneficiary). Cost is the credit price plus service fee plus executor gas, all deducted from the signed authorization budget.

data.current_summary: Retire carbon credits, paid with a signed x402 authorization
data.current_description: Use to retire carbon credits and receive the Carbonmark certificate in one call. Non-custodial: the payer's signed USDC (EIP-3009) or kVCM (EIP-2612) authorization funds the settlement contract directly, and the service only relays it. POST without `authPayload` to receive the 402 challenge; POST again with the signature in `authPayload`, posting `actionsRetireRequest` verbatim (including `salt`). Cost is the retirement price + fee + executor gas, all inside the signed budget; any unspent budget is refunded in the same transaction.
data.description_suggestion: Executes a retirement transaction funded by a signed authorization, returning the Carbonmark certificate in one call. Non-custodial: the payer's signed USDC (EIP-3009) or kVCM (EIP-2612) authorization funds the settlement contract directly; the service only relays it. Workflow: (1) POST without `authPayload` to receive the x402 402 challenge with `typedData`; (2) sign the `typedData`; (3) POST again with the signature in `authPayload`, sending the `actionsRetireRequest` verbatim including `salt`. Cost is the credit price plus service fee plus executor gas, all deducted from the signed budget; any unspent amount is refunded in the same transaction.
